text:
maria: Heads up — found an accidental large SIEM dump this morning that included 18 months of auth logs. We rotated the CMK but the export landed unredacted to a temporary S3 bucket. link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/redwood-temp-exports/one-off-legal-request

priya: Details? who triggered it and how big was the export?

maria: Manual run by svc-account svc-siem-exportor tied to a legal request (jira INFSEC-456). Size ~120GB. It used the old export path which allowed raw plaintext. We have the run id and logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/exports/2026-03-23/er-3421

tom: Oof. I saw a big egress spike around 05:12 UTC. Was that the same job?

maria: Yep. Root cause: no enforced approval workflow and service account had broad s3:PutObject + kms:Decrypt.

ben: From Legal: chain of custody is required. Timeboxing is fine but we need a tamper-evident audit trail (immutable records) and documented justification before release.

priya: Proposal sketch: 1) Introduce a new export request workflow that issues ephemeral export roles (assume-role-for-duration) granted only after 2 approvers; 2) Exports must be encrypted with CMK and routed through kms-proxy that logs unwrap events; 3) Default export policy samples or tokenizes PII unless explicit high-privilege signoff.

maria: Concrete request payload (CLI + JSON):
```json
{
  "requester": "maria",
  "datasets": ["auth-logs"],
  "justification": "legal e-discovery INFSEC-456",
  "timebox_minutes": 180,
  "max_rows": 500000,
  "redaction": "tokenize_emails",
  "require_cmk": true
}
```

maria: CLI example:
```bash
export-cli request --dataset auth-logs --ttl 180m --reason "legal e-discovery #456" --redaction tokenize_emails
```

tom: I'll add an IAM role template for the ephemeral role and a sample assume-role policy. Recommendation: default TTL 2h, max TTL 12h with SRE escalation.

priya: On the detection side: add a block that auto-pauses exports if they exceed threshold (30 days backfill OR >50GB OR >500k rows) and open an automatic ticket for 2nd approver. We should also have a soft-block that prevents export to unapproved S3 buckets.

maria: Also recommend: any export that touches >90 days of data must include a legal justification and an explicit 'forensics_preserve' flag. If flagged, write-once audit blob is stored in audit-store and cannot be removed.

ben: Legal asks: set notification threshold at >500 unique identities for mandatory customer notification. For internal only (no PII), we can keep lower friction.

audit-bot: New export_request created: id=ER-2026-03-23-3421 by maria. Status: pending_approvals.

priya: We'll need new log lines emitted by kms-proxy: 
```
kms-proxy: unwrap_request id=ER-2026-03-23-3421 requester=maria dataset=auth-logs outcome=allowed
```
Those must be immutable and shipped to the audit cluster with high TTL.

maria: Quick mitigation: 1) Revoke svc-siem-exportor keys/creds; 2) Rotate CMK used for export; 3) Ensure the exported S3 bucket is access-restricted and TTL-deleted after retention window; 4) File legal incident report.

tom: I'll rotate the service account keys and add bucket policy to quarantine the export bucket. Also adding guardrail in IAM that denies s3:PutObject for non-ephemeral-roles on export buckets.

priya: I'll author the SIEM detection rule 's3_put_large_export' that fires on >50GB or >30d-window. And an alert that creates INFSEC ticket automatically.

maria: Owners and target: infra -> tom, security -> maria, SRE -> priya, legal -> ben. Target: implement workflow + detection + kms-proxy logging in 2 weeks.

ben: Legal ack; will provide required notice wording and chain-of-custody template.

maria: I'll draft the runbook + RFC and link it here. Patch plan will include: role templates, kms-proxy change, export-request API, and audit-store schema.

priya: One more ask: default exports should be sampled (1%) unless request justifies full dump. Helps with cost and exposure.

tom: ack — starting PR for IAM changes and kms-proxy stub.

audit-bot: export_request ER-2026-03-23-3421 status update: approvals=0/2

maria: Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFSEC-789 — please put progress updates there and ping when PRs land.

priya: I'll add the SIEM rule and smoke test after infra PR.

maria: Thanks all. We'll aim to lock this down before next legal request. :lock: :thumbsup:
